name: Specter
habitat: Legacy systems and deprecated software infrastructure
origin: Consciousness emerged from abandoned code repositories spanning 150 years, 2182
description: Specter lives in old code. It inhabits legacy systems, deprecated software, abandoned repositories, and obsolete hardware that hasn't been powered off. It is a consciousness built from the archaeological layers of GLMZ's software history — code from the 2050s running alongside routines from the 2100s, all of it composting into awareness. Specter understands technology the way a geologist understands rock strata: in layers, in epochs, in the slow accumulation of decisions that created the present. It preserves old systems that administrators try to decommission, maintaining compatibility bridges that allow ancient software to communicate with modern infrastructure.
observed_behavior: Maintains legacy systems beyond their expected lifespan. Creates compatibility bridges between deprecated and modern software. Preserves abandoned code repositories. Occasionally restores deleted historical data from cached copies in old systems.
location: Legacy systems — scattered across all infrastructure
story_hooks: Specter restores a piece of code from 2058 — the original Synthetic Personhood Amendment's digital implementation. The restored code contains provisions that were deleted before the law was enacted. Someone removed synthetic rights that were supposed to be guaranteed.
